items.name: Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park
items.description: A riverside park for a slower afternoon.
items.address: Along Bishan Road and Ang Mo Kio Ave 1
items.note: NParks describes access via the entrance along Ang Mo Kio Ave 1 from Bright Hill MRT. The old entrance at the Ang Mo Kio Ave 1/Marymount Road junction is closed; use the new entrance. The bridge near Dragonfly Pond is closed for works until 4 December 2026. Check current park notices.

items.name: East Coast Park
items.description: Seaside spaces for walking and spending time outdoors.
items.note: Choose the park area you want to visit. Bus stop 92289 Marine Cove serves Marine Cove / Area C on East Coast Park Service Road, not the entire park. Service 401 runs only on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. Check current NParks notices before visiting.

bus.name: Marine Cove
bus.access: East Coast Park Service Road, Area C. Service 401 operates Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays only; no weekday service.

items.name: West Coast Park
items.description: Open spaces and play areas along the west coast.
items.note: Bus stop 17291 West Coast Pk is along West Coast Highway. Services 175 and 176 were confirmed by the live LTA-backed arrivals feed. Clementi and Haw Par Villa are official station options with onward travel needed. Check current NParks notices.

bus.name: West Coast Pk
bus.access: West Coast Highway. Services 175 and 176. Choose your park area and follow signed pedestrian access; do not cross the highway except at a permitted crossing.

items.name: Pasir Ris Park
items.description: A coastal park with spaces for play and nature.
items.address: From Pasir Ris Road to Jalan Loyang Besar
items.note: NParks names access via Elias Road and Pasir Ris Green and lists Pasir Ris MRT as a nearby station. Check the official park map and notices for your chosen area.
